name: openbuild
description: Autonomous repository-grounded planning, implementation, validation, and exact-model agent review for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, and review from one durable specification
interface.longDescription: Turn an idea or existing specification into a repository-grounded plan and implementation. OpenBuild routes discovery, bounded writing, and sequential review through a configurable model map and separate Codex CLI processes with explicit model, reasoning-effort, and sandbox receipts.
defaultPrompt: Use Build in auto mode to complete this task.
Refine this specification against the current repository.
Execute this specification and review the result.
